draft.title: The future of work
card: Work keeps changing. Some jobs shrink or disappear, and new jobs appear that did not exist before.
Nobody can say exactly which jobs will exist in 20 years. This is why skills that suit many jobs are expected to matter more than training for one job only.
Skills expected to matter more include problem solving (finding a way through a new challenge), digital skills (using technology well) and adaptability (adjusting to change).
Lifelong learning means continuing to learn new skills throughout a working life, not only at school. It helps workers adapt when their jobs change.
draft.remember: Jobs will keep changing, so skills that can be used in many jobs, and ongoing learning, are expected to matter more.

a.q: Why is lifelong learning expected to matter more in the future of work?
opts: Jobs keep changing, so workers need to learn new skills
Jobs will stay the same, so workers must repeat old skills
School learning stops being useful once a person is working
Only computer workers will need to keep on learning
a.why: If jobs keep changing, workers who keep learning can adapt to new tasks and new jobs. The option about jobs staying the same is wrong because the card says work keeps changing.
a.clue: Think about what workers need when their jobs change.

b.q: Tom is choosing what to learn for his future career. Nobody can be sure which jobs will exist in 20 years. Which choice best prepares him?
opts: Build problem solving and digital skills that suit many jobs
Master one task that his chosen job needs right now
Avoid new technology so that he can keep his current skills
Stop studying once he has found his first job
b.why: Skills such as problem solving and digital skills can be used across many jobs, so they help when work changes. Mastering one task is tempting, but it may not be needed if that job changes or disappears.
b.clue: Which choice still helps if his job changes?

a.best: Jobs keep changing, so workers need to learn new skills

b.best: Build problem solving and digital skills that suit many jobs
